answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond for one canyon desalination unit. The unit draws seawater through a single inlet and meters intake and output. Auditors recompute output from the basalt ledger at 45 percent recovery, allowing 2 percent tolerance. A claim beyond tolerance, or a reading reused by another unit, burns the bond. Fees rise per funder: first 26, kth 26 plus 7 times k minus 1, 1000th 7019; 1000 fakes pay 3,522,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-intake ring fails: one meter key binds one unit, so reuse burns both. An honest operator pays 26 once, then recovers the bond.
